question.zh-CN: 如何把任务目标转成连续、稳定且符合动力学的动作？
question.en: How are task goals converted into continuous, stable and dynamically feasible actions?

problem.zh-CN: 寻找可达、无碰撞的动作路径。
problem.en: Find reachable and collision-free motion paths.

research.zh-CN: 约束求解、采样与优化规划。
research.en: Constraint solving, sampling and optimization planning.

industry.zh-CN: 机器人模型、碰撞几何与执行时间参数化。
industry.en: Robot models, collision geometry and execution timing.

compare.zh-CN: 规划成功率、计算时间与碰撞余量。
compare.en: Planning success, computation time and collision margins.

problem.zh-CN: 在动力学约束下滚动调整动作。
problem.en: Adapt actions under dynamics constraints in a receding horizon.

research.zh-CN: 模型误差、约束优化与稳定性。
research.en: Model error, constrained optimization and stability.

industry.zh-CN: 实时求解、状态估计与故障降级。
industry.en: Real-time solving, state estimation and degraded operation.

compare.zh-CN: 求解最坏时延、跟踪误差与约束违反。
compare.en: Worst-case solve time, tracking error and constraint violations.

problem.zh-CN: 在接触中控制力与柔顺性。
problem.en: Regulate force and compliance during contact.

research.zh-CN: 接触切换、未知刚度与安全探索。
research.en: Contact transitions, unknown stiffness and safe exploration.

industry.zh-CN: 工艺整定、传感标定与过载保护。
industry.en: Process tuning, sensor calibration and overload protection.

compare.zh-CN: 接触力误差、超调与损伤率。
compare.en: Force error, overshoot and damage rate.

problem.zh-CN: 协调平衡、行走、手臂与接触点。
problem.en: Coordinate balance, locomotion, arms and contacts.

research.zh-CN: 运动模仿、落脚规划与多接触优化。
research.en: Motion imitation, foothold planning and multi-contact optimization.

industry.zh-CN: 本体约束、热负载、跌倒恢复。
industry.en: Body limits, thermal load and fall recovery.

compare.zh-CN: 地形通过率、能耗与恢复能力。
compare.en: Terrain completion, energy use and recovery capability.

name.zh-CN: 模仿与扩散、流动作策略

problem.zh-CN: 从示范学习多模态动作分布。
problem.en: Learn multimodal action distributions from demonstrations.

research.zh-CN: 动作表示、时间建模与误差累积。
research.en: Action representations, temporal modeling and compounding error.

industry.zh-CN: 采集成本、推理时延与控制频率匹配。
industry.en: Collection cost, inference latency and control-rate matching.

compare.zh-CN: 成功率、动作平滑性与端到端时延。
compare.en: Success, action smoothness and end-to-end latency.

problem.zh-CN: 通过反馈改进策略并适应变化。
problem.en: Improve policies through feedback and adapt to changes.

research.zh-CN: 奖励设计、样本效率与安全学习。
research.en: Reward design, sample efficiency and safe learning.

industry.zh-CN: 真实试错成本、接管与回滚。
industry.en: Real-world trial cost, takeover and rollback.

compare.zh-CN: 新增交互量、风险暴露与持续性能。
compare.en: Additional interactions, risk exposure and sustained performance.
